method: Regular-market foreign volume valued at each daily close. These are estimates, not official executed foreign values. Screen: at least Rp10tn market value and Rp10bn 20-session average daily value at the 30 October close. Twenty-session averages and weekly sums for focus stocks are recomputed from the daily rows below. Market value is shares outstanding times the close.

freshExport.basis: Liquid large caps only: market value of at least Rp10tn and average daily trading of at least Rp10bn over 20 days, at the week's last close. Regular market only. IDX gives foreign trading per stock in shares, so values are shares times each day's closing price.
